🤍 Our Story

About Nabda OTP

Nabda OTP is the first Arab WhatsApp gateway — built by Arab developers, for developers everywhere. We offer unlimited WhatsApp messaging for a flat $10/month.

Our Mission

We believe every developer — regardless of their location or budget — should have access to affordable, reliable WhatsApp messaging. Nabda OTP was founded to make the best WhatsApp API accessible to everyone, from solo developers to large enterprises.

While global providers charge $0.005–$0.05 per message, we offer a simple flat fee: $10/month for unlimited messages. No surprises. No scaling bills. Just reliable WhatsApp OTP delivery at a price everyone can afford.

The First Arab WhatsApp Gateway

Nabda OTP was founded with a focus on the Arab world — Iraq, Syria, Saudi Arabia, UAE, and the broader MENA region. We are the first WhatsApp API provider to offer:

  • Full Arabic Unicode support for messages and documentation
  • RTL (right-to-left) text handling for Arabic content
  • Arabic language customer support
  • Deep understanding of MENA telecom infrastructure
  • Local market expertise in Iraq, Syria, and the Gulf states

Why We Built Nabda OTP

As Arab developers, we experienced firsthand how expensive and complex WhatsApp API integration was. Twilio charged per message, making it impractical for startups. The setup processes were complex and designed for enterprise, not for developers who need a simple, affordable solution.

Nabda OTP was born from this frustration. We wanted a simple API, transparent pricing, and a product that understood the Arab market. Today, thousands of developers use Nabda OTP to power their applications' verification and messaging needs.
